# Sorrel

> Sorrel is a local, evidence-oriented tabular data-analysis application with Streamlit and CLI entry points.

## Start Here

- [Product overview](/docs/overview.md): Shipped capabilities and boundaries.
- [Analysis workflow](/docs/workflow.md): The canonical seven-stage local workflow.
- [Safety and privacy](/docs/safety.md): Local data handling and sandbox safeguards.

## Integrate

There is no REST API or MCP server in the current release. Use the local CLI or
Streamlit workspace; do not treat local artefact JSON as a stable remote schema.

## Reference

- [Supported files](/docs/file-formats.md): Local reader formats and row cap.
- [Runtime limits](/docs/limits.md): Local configurable defaults.
- [Changelog](/docs/changelog.md): Public contract changes.
